purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: ethics lecture; formal vocabulary (行為/行う/および/に関する) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 研究を行う上で、倫理は欠かせません。
lines.en: In conducting research, ethics are essential.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 倫理に関する規則は、厳しいんですか?
lines.en: Are the rules about ethics strict?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はい、人に関する研究は特に慎重です。
lines.en: Yes — research involving people is especially careful.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 無断で記録する行為は、許されません。
lines.en: Recording without consent is not permitted.
lines.style: firm teacher voice, soft warm measured serious clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実験は、どこで行われるんですか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大学および研究所で、行われます。
lines.en: They're conducted at universities and institutes.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 記録および報告も、必要なんですね。
lines.en: So records and reports are necessary too.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 誠実な行為が、研究を支えます。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout
